data.one_liner: A 2D Bézier curve math library supporting quadratic and cubic curves.
data.what_it_does: Provides mathematical operations and algorithms for 2D Bézier curves, such as calculating points at parameter values, finding tangents and normals, computing arc lengths, bounding boxes, and finding intersections.
use_when: You need to calculate Bézier curve coordinates, lengths, or normals in your application
You are building custom graphics, animations, or drawing tools requiring curve math
avoid_when: You only need standard UI layout widgets without custom curve calculation requirements
You require 3D curve calculations instead of 2D
strengths: Supports both quadratic and cubic 2D Bézier curves
Platform-independent and context-independent pure Dart library
Includes robust features like offset curves, arc length approximations, and intersection calculations
weaknesses: Limited strictly to 2D math (no 3D curve support)
Requires manual integration with vector_math and rendering code
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import vector_math alongside bezier.
